verdict.rationale: Filee is a file-conversion tool, and conversion products can plausibly ship language SDKs, so this axis applies. The evidence shows only a desktop app and an official CLI with `--json` output and exit codes for scripting. That CLI is an adjacent capability, not vendor-maintained, versioned client libraries for mainstream languages. No HTTP API was found (OpenAPI probes returned 404), and no SDK or package is documented.
